environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod in ci-runners namespace. Istio sidecar injected with STRICT PeerAuthentication policy at namespace level. The Istio DestinationRule for all mesh-internal services requires ISTIO_MUTUAL TLS mode. Additionally, a Sidecar resource scopes egress to only hosts listed in a ServiceEntry whitelist. External egress passes through an egress gateway pod that terminates mTLS from the source and re-initiates connections outbound. The egress gateway's EnvoyFilter applies a custom Lua filter that resolves DNS at connection time and compares against the original SNI/Host header - connections where resolved IP differs from the IP at filter evaluation are reset (anti-rebinding). For non-mesh destinations (like cloud metadata), the NetworkPolicy only permits egress to the egress-gateway pod on port 15443; direct pod-to-metadata-service traffic on 169.254.169.254 is denied by a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy with a specific CIDR deny rule on the node-local link-local range.

config.istio_sidecar_resource: egress restricted to registered ServiceEntry hosts
config.egress_gateway: envoy with Lua DNS-rebinding detection filter (compares resolved IP at connect vs initial resolution, RST on mismatch)
config.cilium_network_policy: deny egress to 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8 except via egress-gateway on port 15443
config.mtls_requirement: all internal service communication requires valid SPIFFE identity from source workload
